benchmarks: Two custom Chinese-language benchmark scenarios (Default, High-Confusion, own); LongMemEval (external, 500 queries)
fallos_mitigaciones: The low-confidence rejection rule addresses spurious recalls when no answer exists in the memory store (S3.6, threshold tau=0.50 tuned via sweep). Separately, tag-signature deduplication -- intended to prevent template duplicates from crowding out results -- COUNTER-INTUITIVELY HURTS recall on the tag-free LongMemEval fact-granularity dataset: the full pipeline underperforms a vector-only baseline by 5.0pp Hit@5 because all fact-level memories share an identical (empty) tag signature, so dedup discards co-relevant facts from the same session (S5.4, Table7); this contrasts with the SAME mechanism improving Hit@3 by +2.7pp on the tagged custom scenarios (Table9), showing the mitigation is data-dependent and can itself become a failure mode.
cita: Sun (2026). MemX: A Local-First Long-Term Memory System for AI Assistants.
notes: S3.2 Data Model: memories table (content/embedding/type/tags/metadata/importance + access_count/retrieval_count + timestamps) + memory_links table (7 relation types: similar/related/contradicts/extends/supersedes/caused_by/temporal, NOT YET integrated into the search pipeline -- 'planned extension', S2/S6) -> mem_tipos=SEMANTICA(user facts/preferences)+PROCEDIMENTAL(explicit 'procedural' memory type: deployment checklists, debugging strategies, incident procedures)+EPISODICA(incident resolutions), representacion=HIBRIDA (vector+FTS5-text+link-table-graph, though graph unused in retrieval). fidelidad_procedencia=NO (conservative call): memory_links SCHEMA explicitly supports contradicts/supersedes/temporal relations but is not yet functionally wired into retrieval -- treated as a planned/unimplemented feature, spot-check flag. Algorithm1/S3.3-3.6: hybrid pipeline -- embed query (Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, 1024-dim) -> parallel vector recall (DiskANN/brute-force cosine) + FTS5 keyword recall -> RRF fusion (k=60) -> four-factor re-rank (semantic/recency/frequency/importance, Eq.1-3) -> z-score+sigmoid normalize (Eq.4) -> low-confidence rejection gate -> content+tag-signature dedup -> top-k + stats write-back -> retrieval=EMBEDDINGS(vector)+RANKING(RRF/four-factor rerank)+GREP-ARCHIVOS(FTS5 keyword full-text), operaciones=WRITE(insertion)+ACTUALIZACION(retrieval_count/last_retrieved_at written back on EVERY search, Algorithm1 line11, S3.7 explicit access-vs-retrieval separation). trigger=NA: paper is retrieval-pipeline-focused; the WRITE-time policy for creating new memory entries is never detailed. mide_lectura=SI: Hit@k/MRR/Coverage@k/Miss-Empty-Rate/Miss-Strict-Rate are the paper's core evaluation currency (Table3, Table5-6) -> RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO in F. Table3: Default scenario Hit@1=91.3%/MRR=0.935 (1,014 records); High-Confusion Hit@1=100%/Coverage@5=75% (600 records) -> BENCHMARK-E2E. S5.4 Table5-6 LongMemEval (500 Qs, 4 ability types, 3 granularities session/round/fact): fact-level DOUBLES Hit@5 (24.6%->51.6%) and MRR (0.183->0.380) vs session-level; temporal/multi-session reasoning remain weak (<=43.6% Hit@5, 'confirming these abilities require mechanisms beyond single-query vector recall... that MemX does not yet implement') -> NEGATIVO(b) limitation finding. S5.5/Table8: FTS5 vs naive LIKE keyword search gives a 1,100x speedup at 100,486 records (3,483ms->34.6ms), keeping end-to-end search under 90ms at 220,349 records -> COSTO in F, metricas=LATENCIA, evidencia_tipo=MEDICION-COSTO. S5.6 Table9 cumulative pipeline-component ablation (V/V+K/V+K+Rej/Full) + S5.3 Table4 rejection-threshold sweep -> evidencia_tipo=ABLATION. alcance=SESION: explicit 'single-user, locally-deployed AI assistant' framing, persisting across many interaction sessions (LongMemEval spans 19,195 sessions), not project-code-scoped. F_screening was RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO;COSTO; full text confirms and adds WRITE and NEGATIVO.

fallos_mitigaciones: Synchronous 'append-and-evolve-all' systems (e.g. A-MEM) process EVERY utterance through an O(N^2) evolution pipeline, causing 'severe write-latency, unbounded API token costs, and catastrophic context window pollution caused by conversational noise' (S1); mitigated via the RPE-gated Critic Router that tiers inputs into SKIP/CONSTRUCT_ONLY/FULL_EVOLUTION. Separately, the paper self-reports its own limitation: the Utility-based skip mechanism causes A-MEM to lead on Single-hop retrieval (44.7% vs 21.6%) because 'short, low-complexity factual statements... receive near-zero Utility scores and are correctly routed to SKIP' -- described as 'a principled efficiency trade-off rather than a system failure' (S5.1/S6.1).
cita: Song and Xin (2026). D-MEM: Dopamine-Gated Agentic Memory via Reward Prediction Error Routing.
notes: S4.1-4.2: Agentic RPE = bounded multiplicative gate RPE(xt)=min(1.0, I(Utility>=tau)*[Utility*(Surprise+beta)]) combining Z-score-normalized semantic Surprise (cosine-similarity vs sliding-window historical mean/std, correcting embedding anisotropy) + LLM-classified long-term Utility (Transient/Short-Term/Persistent tiers, JSON-schema-constrained lightweight LLM call) -> trigger=DISCRECIONAL-LLM(utility classification uses an LLM call)+PRESUPUESTO(the whole architecture is an explicit compute-budget/cost-aware tiered gate). Critic Router routes each turn via theta_low=0.3/theta_high=0.7 into SKIP(bypass,0 cost)/CONSTRUCT_ONLY(O(1) atomic node into fast STM buffer)/FULL_EVOLUTION(O(N) deep graph restructuring: dynamic linking + retroactive update of historical nodes, reserved for 'factual contradictions or paradigm-shifting preference changes') -> operaciones=WRITE(Note Construction)+ADMISION(the tiered RPE gate IS an admission-control mechanism)+CONSOLIDACION(FULL_EVOLUTION graph restructuring/linking)+ACTUALIZACION(retroactive update of historical nodes). mem_tipos=EPISODICA(per-utterance atomic memory nodes)+SEMANTICA(evolving knowledge-graph facts/preferences, inherited A-MEM paradigm), representacion=HIBRIDA(knowledge graph + vector embeddings for surprise/retrieval + raw-text STM/Shadow buffers). fidelidad_procedencia=SI: FULL_EVOLUTION is explicitly triggered by and designed to resolve 'factual contradictions' and 'continuously resolve conflicts... maintain a highly accurate, contradiction-free internal state' (S1/S3.2) -> FIDELIDAD in F. S4.3 Zero-Cost Retrieval Augmentation: hybrid BM25+vector RRF fusion (entity precision) + O(1) Shadow-Buffer FIFO fallback (raw text of SKIPped turns, defends adversarial queries) -> retrieval=EMBEDDINGS;RANKING;GRAFO. mide_lectura=SI: S5.1-5.2 Table1-2 report per-category F1/BLEU (Single/Temporal/Open/Multi-hop/Adversarial) -> RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO in F. S2 introduces the LoCoMo-Noise benchmark (own): LLM-injected Filler(40%)/Status(30%)/Tangent(30%) noise at ratio rho=0.75 around preserved 'needle' QA turns -> BENCHMARK-E2E, alcance=SESION. S5.2 Table1 headline: vs synchronous A-MEM under rho=0.75 noise, D-MEM cuts total tokens 1,648K->319K (-80%) while IMPROVING Overall F1 (0.369 vs 0.336), Multi-hop (0.412 vs 0.365), and Adversarial (0.412 vs 0.388, via Shadow-Buffer fallback) -> COSTO in F, metricas=COSTO-TOKENS, evidencia_tipo=MEDICION-COSTO. Fig.2-3 RPE component decomposition (Surprise vs Utility scatter, tier-assignment over 700 turns) -> evidencia_tipo=ABLATION. F_screening was COSTO;RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO; full text confirms and adds WRITE, CONSOLIDACION, FIDELIDAD, NEGATIVO.

fallos_mitigaciones: 'Lossy abstraction' from query-agnostic memory compression is the central problem addressed: aggressive query-independent compression strips crucial contextual nuance (unstated temporal logic, multi-hop dependencies), leaving agents unable to answer queries requiring rigorous deduction (S1); mitigated via a query-guided System2 Full-Deliberation fallback + Quality-Gating escalation policy. Separately, an honest negative finding: 'When deploying Qwen3-235B-Instruct on the highly noisy RealTalk dataset, the addition of explicit filtering counterintuitively degrades performance compared to the unfiltered Mem0* (e.g. LLM score drops from 62.5 to 60.0)... erroneous pruning of critical context' (S4.2) -- aggressive context filtering is model-alignment-dependent and can itself hurt.
cita: You et al. (2026). D-Mem: A Dual-Process Memory System for LLM Agents.
notes: S3.1 Mem0* (System1, enhanced Mem0): Extraction Phase conditions LLM on top-10 similar existing memories + last-8-messages -> extracts salient memories Omega; Update Phase retrieves top-5 similar historical memories per omega_i, DISCARDS low-relevance items via cosine-similarity threshold>0.8 (ADMISION), then an LLM cross-references new-vs-background memories for contradictions/redundancies -> dictates ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NOOP per item (Fig.1 PartA) -> operaciones=WRITE(ADD)+ADMISION(cosine>0.8 filter)+CONSOLIDACION(contradiction/redundancy cross-referencing)+OLVIDO(DELETE)+ACTUALIZACION(UPDATE) -- ALL 5 non-NA operaciones tokens explicitly present. mem_tipos=EPISODICA(per-turn extracted facts)+SEMANTICA(salient conversational facts/preferences), representacion=HIBRIDA(vector DB System1 + raw chunked dialogue text System2 Full Deliberation). trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA ('The maintenance pipeline dynamically triggers upon the ingestion of the new interaction round at step t', S3.1). retrieval=EMBEDDINGS(top-K/30/10/5 vector similarity throughout)+RANKING(0-10 relevance scoring + multi-stage filtering, S3.3). fidelidad_procedencia=SI: explicit LLM cross-referencing of new-vs-background memories 'to evaluate potential contradictions and redundancies' (S3.1) PLUS the Quality-Gating rubric's 'Faithfulness & Consistency' dimension (S3.2) -> FIDELIDAD in F. mide_lectura=SI: F1/LLM-as-judge/BLEU across LoCoMo+RealTalk (Table1-2, per-category breakdown Fig.2), and Quality Gating literally assesses the initial retrieved answer's Relevance/Faithfulness/Completeness before deciding whether to escalate -> RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO in F. Table1: Quality Gating (ours) reaches F1=53.5/LLM=76.3 on LoCoMo (GPT-4o-mini) vs Mem0*=51.2/72.7, recovering 96.7% of Full-Deliberation's F1 (55.3) using only 35.8% of its tokens and ~1/3 the latency; RealTalk shows a consistent pattern -> BENCHMARK-E2E, COSTO in F, metricas=COSTO-TOKENS;LATENCIA, evidencia_tipo=MEDICION-COSTO. Fig.2 per-category F1 gain of Quality-Gating over Mem0* scales with question difficulty (Single-Hop smallest, Temporal/Open-Domain largest) -> evidencia_tipo=ABLATION (3-policy comparison Majority-Voting/Consensus/Quality-Gating, Table1-2 fallback-rate breakdown). alcance=SESION (LoCoMo 10 long-term dialogues ~24K tokens avg / RealTalk 10 conversations ~16K words avg). F_screening was RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO;COSTO; full text confirms and adds WRITE, CONSOLIDACION, FIDELIDAD, NEGATIVO.

fallos_mitigaciones: Key finding: the small (8B) model WITHOUT memory 'does not hedge. It fabricates plausible answers about user-specific facts it has never seen' with sufficient token-level confidence to pass the routing threshold (cold-compound F1=13.0% vs warm-compound F1=30.5%, S5.B); mitigated by cross-model memory injection ('memory transforms confidently wrong into confidently right'). Contribution3 further characterizes a failure mode of the raw-verbatim-turn-pair memory design itself: 'Turn-pair memories are most effective for factual recall (+28.9 F1 for single-hop) and counterproductive for temporal reasoning (-3.8 F1), identifying where structured memory representations are needed.'
cita: Liu et al. (2026). Knowledge Access Beats Model Size: Memory Augmented Routing for Persistent AI Agents.
notes: S3-A Cross-Model Memory Injection: after EACH inference call, the routing layer stores the VERBATIM conversation turn-pair (Q+A, session-timestamp-prefixed) + Matryoshka embedding + user-level metadata into a Milvus vector DB, partitioned by user (multi-tenant isolation) -> operaciones=WRITE only (explicit design choice: 'we store verbatim conversation turn-pairs rather than LLM-generated summaries, avoiding the hallucination risk that would compound with retrieval noise' -- no ADMISION/CONSOLIDACION/OLVIDO/ACTUALIZACION found), trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA ('After each inference call...'), mem_tipos=EPISODICA (explicit verbatim-turn-pair design), representacion=HIBRIDA (dense Matryoshka embeddings + BM25 sparse index, S3-D). retrieval=EMBEDDINGS(cosine over Matryoshka embeddings)+RANKING(BM25 n-gram + RRF/weighted/BM25-dominant fusion, S3-D). mide_lectura=SI: the entire paper is a direct causal measurement of memory-read utility on downstream F1 -> RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO in F. fidelidad_procedencia=NO: no staleness/contradiction/consistency-across-sources mechanism for memory CONTENT is implemented (turn-pairs simply appended verbatim; 'RAG poisoning' is cited only as an external risk, not a mechanism this paper builds). Table1/abstract: memory injection raises 8B from 15.4%->30.5% F1 (+15.0pp), recovering 69% of full-context-235B quality (43.9%) at 96% lower EffCost; a 235B model WITHOUT memory (13.7% F1) underperforms even the standalone 8B (15.4% F1) -- the 'knowledge access beats model size' headline is itself NEGATIVO(b)-flavored -> NEGATIVO in F. Table2 2x2 factorial (memory x routing): routing is 'nearly independent of memory' (96%/100% queries stay on 8B with/without memory); the difference is answer quality -> evidencia_tipo=ABLATION (2x2 factorial) + BENCHMARK-E2E (Table1 vs published Mem0/Zep/LangMem baselines on LoCoMo) + MEDICION-COSTO (EffCost=(input+4*output)*(P/8) explicitly defined and tracked, Table3: compound strategy 30.5% F1 at 22K EffCost, 96% cheaper than cold-235B). S4 LongMemEval hybrid-retrieval ablation (Table4-5, 100 stratified questions): hybrid BM25+cosine improves F1 by +7.7 over cosine-only (36.5->44.2) -> further ABLATION anchor. handoff=CONTENIDO: 'Cross-Model Memory Injection' explicitly makes memories accumulated from ANY model (including the large one) available to ALL subsequent models (including the small one) -- full turn-pair CONTENT travels across model/inference-call boundaries for the same user over the agent's persistent lifetime. alcance=SESION: LoCoMo (19 sessions, 214 turns) and LongMemEval (~48 sessions/~121K tokens per question) are multi-session persistent-agent benchmarks; store is 'partitioned by user' -> multiagente=NO (cross-MODEL sharing within one user's memory, not sharing across distinct agents/users). F_screening was COSTO;RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO; full text confirms and adds WRITE and NEGATIVO.

benchmarks: LongBench (multi-document QA, real Llama-3-8B integration, S4.2); synthetic 1024-slot 'Long-Context Benchmark' simulation vs vanilla-RAG/Mem0-style baselines (S4.1, own/unnamed)
fallos_mitigaciones: Theorem3.1 'Necessity of Pruning or Compression' proves any finite-capacity memory receiving unbounded input MUST implement pruning or compression to maintain retrieval fidelity above epsilon>0 -- the unbounded-growth/sobre-retencion failure mode; mitigated via the Irreversible-Loss (pruning) + Subspace-Mapping (compression) operator pair (S2.5 'Capacity as an Emergent Constraint'). The real-world validation (Table3) shows this bounding comes at a real, honestly-reported cost: F1 QA accuracy on LongBench DROPS from 48.2 to 47.1 (-2.2%) in exchange for 4.2x token compression and a bounded 8GB memory ceiling.
cita: Yazir (2026). SNT-MEM: Operator-Structured Memory Management Framework for Self-Regulating AI Systems.
notes: RECONSIDERAR: this paper is a highly abstract, quantum-formalism-heavy theoretical framework (density operators/CPTP maps/von-Neumann entropy over generic 'memory modes', S2) whose PRIMARY validation is a synthetic simulation (Table2: 1024-slot memory, 1000 timesteps, vs vanilla-RAG/Mem0-style baselines that are not concretely specified as real systems, S4.1); only S4.2 (2 sentences) + Table3 touches a real model (Llama-3-8B on LongBench multi-doc QA), and even there the 'Baseline' configuration is left unspecified -- extraction proceeds per protocol but the thin real-world grounding + heavy abstraction warrants human reconsideration of inclusion. S2.2 Eq.3: memory evolves via a FIXED composition of all 7 CPTP operators applied EVERY timestep -> trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA (deterministic per-timestep composition, not event/LLM/budget-gated in the ordinary sense). Table1/S2.4 explicit operator-to-memory-function mapping: Irreversible-Loss='low-utility pruning/forgetting' (Eq.9, post-selection+renormalization) -> operaciones includes OLVIDO; Subspace-Mapping='representation transformation/consolidation' (Eq.10, Kraus-operator compression) -> CONSOLIDACION; Liminal='capacity bounds/working memory limit' (Eq.8, soft threshold) -> ADMISION; Table6 defines an explicit Write complexity O(log N) -> WRITE; Cyclic-Reset='bounded refresh cycles/refractory period' (Eq.5) -> ACTUALIZACION -- all 5 non-NA operaciones tokens map onto the 7-operator taxonomy, inferred from an abstract mathematical formalism. mem_tipos=NA and representacion=VECTOR (closest practical analogue to the density-matrix/salience-state formalism): the framework is explicitly content-agnostic, no discussion of WHAT type of information -episodic/semantic/procedural- is stored. retrieval=NA: Table6 gives only complexity classes (Retrieval-cache O(1), Retrieval-store O(log N)) via vague 'Phase Nexter'/'Phase Reverser' operators, no concrete mechanism ever specified. S4.1 Table2 (50 runs, synthetic benchmark): 63.3%+-2.1% memory reduction vs vanilla-RAG, 22.3%+-1.8% vs Mem0-style, 3.8x+-0.3x retrieval speedup -> COSTO in F, metricas=COSTO-TOKENS/OTRA, evidencia_tipo=MEDICION-COSTO. S4.2/Table3 (real Llama-3-8B, LongBench, >32k-token contexts): 4.2x token compression, TTFT 140ms->42ms, memory ceiling unbounded->fixed@8GB, F1 DROPS 48.2->47.1 -> mide_lectura=SI (F1 QA IS measured) -> RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO in F, NEGATIVO in F, evidencia_tipo=BENCHMARK-E2E. S4.3 Table4: systematic per-operator ablation (removing each of 7 operators, measuring Memory/Speed/Consolidation-loss %) shows every operator contributes uniquely -> evidencia_tipo=ABLATION. alcance=TAREA: the only concrete grounding (S4.2) is single-document/single-long-context QA (LongBench), not multi-session persistent dialogue memory. F_screening was CONSOLIDACION;COSTO; full text confirms and adds WRITE, RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO, NEGATIVO.

benchmarks: MS-MARCO (L1 retrieval quality, R@5); 14 own controlled experiments (E1-E14): 12 simulated workloads + 2 live GPT-5.4-nano API measurements (E13/E14); no LoCoMo/LongMemEval/SWE-bench used
fallos_mitigaciones: LLM output stochasticity is a core failure mode addressed: 'the same query run 20 times produces between 2 and 8 syntactically distinct tool call variations' (S1), and E14 confirms raw LLM consistency of only 55-90% (mean 79%) across repeated identical inputs; mitigated via deterministic Stage3 replay (100% consistency by construction). Separately, adversarial/OOD queries risk triggering an UNSAFE fast-path replay on a deceptive input; mitigated via 3 safety coherence checks (slot-extraction-method / template-skeleton-similarity<0.75 / >20%-novel-content-words), achieving zero silent failures across 300 adversarial and out-of-distribution probes (E3, S3.6).
cita: Sertel (2026). Hybrid Governance Architecture: A Self-Improving Memory Substrate for LLM Agents with Progressive Cost Reduction and Deterministic Replay.
notes: S3: three-layer substrate -- L1 Routing Memory (VQ semantic retrieval, 1-byte routing codes, 768x compression vs dense fp32, R@5=0.959 on MS-MARCO retaining 99.6% of dense recall, S3.1) + L2 Deterministic Vault (SHA-256-hashed exact key-value store w/ policy tags PUBLIC/INTERNAL/SENSITIVE/RESTRICTED, accessed only on gate escalation, L1-only exact-match=22.5%/77.5%-near-miss vs L2=100%/0%-near-miss, E4, S3.2) + L3 Semantic Neuron Layer (stores 'routing experience': tool selected + params extracted + extraction method + success, maturing through 4 stages New->Developing->Reliable->Autonomous, Table1, S3.3) -> mem_tipos=EPISODICA(per-decision routing experience)+SEMANTICA(L1 semantic content)+PROCEDIMENTAL(L3 literally stores tool-use DECISION/procedure chains), representacion=HIBRIDA. Governance Gate (S3.4, Algorithm1) fuses confidence(L1)+margin+sensitivity+neuron-maturity(L3) to select 1-of-5 execution paths (Table2) -> operaciones=WRITE(new items)+ADMISION(gate=admission-routing; exact-key/high-sensitivity ALWAYS forced to DeterministicPath)+CONSOLIDACION(S3.5: Active consolidation on every API call updates neuron edge weights; Passive consolidation runs BETWEEN SESSIONS with 6 ops incl. edge-finalization/co-occurrence-mining/codebook-reshaping/vault-compaction, E10: 35 ops/0 LLM calls)+OLVIDO(salience-guided forgetting, S(m)=0.4*recency+0.3*frequency+0.3*importance Eq.1, 4-tier lifecycle keep/summarize/migrate/delete, E11: 1000->614 items=38.6% reduction, RESTRICTED/SENSITIVE items NEVER deleted)+ACTUALIZACION(neuron maturation/edge-weight updates). trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA(active consolidation on every completed query)+CHECKPOINT(passive consolidation runs between sessions)+PRESUPUESTO(drift-detection threshold qerr>1.3x-baseline triggers codebook reshaping E9; the architecture's central thesis IS progressive cost reduction via threshold-gated tiered execution). retrieval=EMBEDDINGS(L1 VQ vector routing)+RANKING(dot-product bucket rerank + score-based token filtering)+GRAFO(L3 neuron edge weights/co-occurrence mining). fidelidad_procedencia=SI: L2 SHA-256 integrity hashes + drift-detection (staleness of routing index) + S3.6 Safety Mechanisms (3 coherence checks verifying a cached decision remains valid before replay, zero silent failures across 300 adversarial/OOD probes) -> FIDELIDAD in F. SEGURIDAD in F: explicit policy-tag access control, sensitivity=HIGH ALWAYS forces exact DeterministicPath (never a semantic near-miss on sensitive data). mide_lectura=SI: E1 R@5(MS-MARCO), E2 gate-accuracy(94% phase-weighted, 0% unsafe-fast-path-rate), E4 L1-vs-L2 exact-match contrast -> RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO in F. S5.4 Table5 E2 gate ABLATION (Full-Gate/No-L3-Signal/No-Sensitivity/No-Margin/Always-L1/Always-LLM): removing L3 signal collapses accuracy 94%->38.7% while removing sensitivity/margin has NO effect under normal workload -> evidencia_tipo=ABLATION. S5.1-5.2 E12(1000-episode sim, 3 phases incl. drift-injection)+E13(400 LIVE GPT-5.4-nano queries): 89.5% cumulative token savings (E12) / 78.1% real-token savings vs Dense-RAG (E13, 15,630 vs 71,479 tokens, Table3) -> COSTO in F, metricas=COSTO-TOKENS, evidencia_tipo=MEDICION-COSTO;BENCHMARK-E2E. S5.3 E14: Stage3 replay achieves 100% deterministic consistency vs the SAME LLM's raw output achieving only 55-90% consistency (mean 79%, Table4) -> NEGATIVO(b) finding about relying on raw unmediated LLM decisions -> NEGATIVO in F, fallos_mitigaciones anchor. handoff=CONTENIDO;CONTRATO: L3 neurons encode a reusable DECISION CONTRACT (which tool, which parameters, how derived) that persists and replays across future episodes/sessions ('Passive consolidation runs between sessions', S3.5). alcance=SESION: framed around a persistent long-running agent across many episodes (E12's 1,000-episode integration test; S4 Workload characterization). F_screening was WRITE;RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO;CONSOLIDACION;COSTO;FIDELIDAD; full text confirms all five and adds SEGURIDAD and NEGATIVO.
